column1: # Reserve scan at sigma 1 (2026-10-21), to place the phase 2 gate. At sigma 1 and
# r 0.30 (phase2b_sigma1.tsv) no bank failed in any arm: the shock takes at most
# ~4% of deposits (99th pct) and cascades averaged 3 agents, so P(run) = 0 and the
# gate could not test the signal. Same reference cell otherwise (k 6, p 0.05, q 0,
# alpha 0.1, mu 0.5, lambda (0.1, 0.9)), uninformative prior only, 250 runs each.
# Every reserve here is above the largest shock, so a failure needs a cascade.
# One single-cell arm per reserve, not one 5-cell arm: GEN_SEED = SEED_OFFSET +
# array index, so in a multi-cell arm each reserve would get different banks.
# Here every arm is task 1 at seed offset 1000 (GEN_SEED 1001), the same five
# initialisations as p2-* and p2b-*: reserves are compared on the same banks.
# Read: P(run) by reserve; rerun the four gate arms at the reserve whose P(run)
